! EVO1
| style="white-space: nowrap; text-align:center;" | Incarnon Form [[File:SeekingFireballs(xWhite).png|center|width=64x64]]
|
* Direct hits charge Incarnon Transmutation; Alt Fire transmutes. Switching back will expend any remaining charge.
* Launches target-seeking fireballs that ricochet towards enemies. 
| colspan="2" style="text-align:center;" | -
|
* Incarnon Form becomes fully automatic and shoots small fireballs that deal pure {{D|Heat}} damage. Upon hitting an enemy, the projectile will ricochet toward '''1''' enemy within '''20''' meters of the initial target. This ricochet has no homing capability and can miss. Projectiles that hit a surface can bounce up to '''2''' times before dissipating on the third impact, but these ricochets do not automatically aim towards enemies.
|-
